guitar.evidence: Eric Johnson is renowned for his meticulously documented 1957/1962-style Fender Stratocaster tone (notably his guitar nicknamed 'Virginia') and has a Fender signature Stratocaster model.

tone.target: glassy Eric Johnson lead with smooth sustain, delay, and touch wah

tone.summary: A bright, high-headroom signal chain utilizing a classic British combo amp model (UK 50) for clarity, paired with compression, boost, chorus, wah, and stereo delay to achieve the signature glassy, sustained lead tone of Eric Johnson.
